title: The runner prints 'check-in sent' for calls that were never placed
method: drove _run_scheduled with a stand-in scheduler and a credential-less config
triggers: cura run --config <config with no twilio block>
observed_at_discovery: voice.call() returned CallResult(answered=False, error="HTTP 401 error: Unable to create record: Authentication Error - No credentials provided") and the console printed '[2026-09-01 14:45] Morning check-in sent to Margaret'. Nothing on stderr, nothing logged, no retry, no caregiver notification. do_morning/do_evening discard CallResult.answered and .error entirely. This is the caregiver's only signal that Cura works, and it reports success on exactly the days it fails.
